content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available – 1 for Project Technical Support II and 1 for Project Nurse II.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Technical Support II: 12th in science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/Engineering or Equivalent) + 5 years' experience in relevant subject/field OR 3-years Graduate degree in relevant subject/field + 2 years' experience in relevant subject. Project Nurse II: Three-year General Nursing & Midwife (GNM) course.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Project Technical Support II: Maximum 30 years. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PWD as per government rules. Project Nurse II: Maximum 28 years. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PWD as per government rules.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Bhubaneswar recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to report on the specified date, which is 20 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Technical Support II and Project Nurse II posts?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for Project Technical Support II and one vacancy for Project Nurse II, totaling 2 vacancies.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Technical Support II?
faq.answer: For Project Technical Support II, candidates need 12th in science with a Diploma (MLT/DMLT/Engineering or Equivalent) and 5 years of experience, or a 3-year Graduate degree with 2 years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for Project Nurse II?
faq.answer: The required qualification for Project Nurse II is a three-year General Nursing & Midwife (GNM) course.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 30 years for Project Technical Support II and 28 years for Project Nurse II.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these posts?
faq.answer: Both Project Technical Support II and Project Nurse II posts offer a salary of Rs. 24,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with their documents.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Walk-in Interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be conducted at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bhubaneswar, Odisha, 751019.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates bring for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring original documents for eligibility and experience, along with a set of photocopies, and a filled application form if required.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.
